You can find sparkling options for your countdown celebration from collections like [Jared's New Year's Eve Jewelry](https://www.jared.com/-new-years-eve-jewelry/c/7000000757?srsltid=AU7gw4VBF_i_roZ9OqqmSwUdUVmOk3KUPmNnA3qeAc9_XoWN6AIQbJR5) , featuring festive earrings, statement necklaces, and bold pieces designed for the big night.[[1]](https://www.jared.com/-new-years-eve-jewelry/c/7000000757?srsltid=AU7gw4VBF_i_roZ9OqqmSwUdUVmOk3KUPmNnA3qeAc9_XoWN6AIQbJR5)

### Popular NYE Jewelry Trends & Styles

- **Sculptural & Yellow Gold:** Bold cuffs, chunky chain necklaces, and vintage-inspired gold pieces are making a strong comeback to catch the evening light and camera flashes.[[1]](https://ajluxe.com/blogs/jewelry-guide/new-years-eve-jewelry-2026)[[2]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/jewelry-trends-2026/?srsltid=AU7gw4UCzyUHLMnXFTabhlWwfRxuTqVpJFczoV5p1kbsnyDP307PF9mv)
- **Shimmering Crystals & Rhinestones:** Chokers, drop earrings, and crystal-accented pieces provide an effortless, high-shine luxury look that pairs naturally with sequins and metallic outfits.[[1]](https://www.anthropologie.com/stories-new-years-outfit-ideas)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:18109255948964223434,catalogid:13474928502034644523,gpcid:14006694009897560027,mid:576462567540075740&ibp=oshop)
- **Festive Novelties:** Fun accessories like the [[Alex and Ani Champagne Bangle Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:48,mid:576462501905322154,imageDocid:1453411079154218303,gpcid:4360660230557426533,headlineOfferDocid:8093465178848621382,catalogid:14345959814688472855,productDocid:12721212469927992745&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiRw7WRspOXAxWuklYBHQwhMBQQxa4PegoIAggACAAIFBAR) Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:48,mid:576462501905322154,imageDocid:1453411079154218303,gpcid:4360660230557426533,headlineOfferDocid:8093465178848621382,catalogid:14345959814688472855,productDocid:12721212469927992745&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiRw7WRspOXAxWuklYBHQwhMBQQxa4PegoIAggACAAIFBAQ) available at Macy's add a playful, celebratory toast-ready touch.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12721212469927992745,catalogid:14345959814688472855,gpcid:4360660230557426533,mid:576462501905322154&ibp=oshop)
